title: Law to require police training on restraining pregnant people
summary: This law would require the NYPD to train officers on laws and policies limiting the use of physical restraints on people in custody who are pregnant or postpartum. It would also require the department to post an annual report through 2032, starting January 30, 2027, on how many officers were and were not trained. The law would take effect 30 days after becoming law.
